purpose: Author utility tariff plans and replay measured vehicle charging load to compare annualised economics, load shifting, band occupancy and source evidence.
primaryGoal: Compare current and alternative rate plans using real observed charging sessions, without mistaking modelled replay savings for a bill or forecast.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local band-occupancy surfaces and rate-editor surfaces repeat border/background/radius chrome rather than existing surface tokens; EvidencePanel repeats similar chrome.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing tokenized surface classes or established Card primitive; keep tariff calculations local and do not create another global card engine.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Repeated immutable rates-map updates and multi-field band rendering dominate the page.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Optionally extract a feature-local rate-band editor with typed TariffRate/update/remove props; preserve all existing draft defaults and wire fields.

responsive.observed: Parameter/editor grids stack below md, occupancy stacks below lg; PageLayout supplies min-w-0 and full width; tables opt into mobileColumns only.

issues.detail: Plan mobileColumns includes only name/structure/current, excluding select and actions. DataTable.tsx:723-725 hides excluded cells below md; expandable defaults false at :480 and page supplies no mobilePresentation or expanded detail. Compare-selection and remove actions therefore have no source-defined mobile equivalent. Result table :595 likewise excludes most economics detail.
issues.fix: Use existing DataTable mobile presentation/detail contract or retain complete horizontally scrollable rows; expose comparison selection, remove, all result costs, demand, warnings and break-even without discarding metadata.

issues.detail: Band label and energy/cost pair share a flex row without a wrapping/min-width strategy; chart names are unbounded X-axis strings at :567.
issues.fix: Allow long labels/value pairs to wrap and check chart tick/table strategy at narrow allocated widths, RTL and enlarged text.

positiveEvidence: Shared Text headings and labelled fields

issues.detail: Compare Toggle has label="" and no aria-label/aria-labelledby. Toggle.tsx:95-102 forwards names to its actual switch, but none is supplied here; table header does not automatically name an embedded switch.
issues.fix: Supply a localized row-specific accessible name such as Compare {{plan}}; preserve switch state and keyboard behavior.

issues.detail: Default end_minute=1440 (:65) is formatted as 24:00 (:71-75) and passed to input type=time (:844-846). Native time controls accept hours 00-23; default end-of-day therefore cannot be represented by that control.
issues.fix: Provide an explicit end-of-day representation mapped back to the same 1440-minute domain value; do not silently change the tariff interval or SI contract. Validate native browser round-trip.

issues.detail: Band share_pct is shown only as an unlabelled visual width at :664; adjacent text exposes energy and cost but not exact share.
issues.fix: Expose the returned percentage as localized text or an appropriately named meter/progress contract alongside existing energy and cost.

accessibility.evidenceLimits: Keyboard/focus order, assistive technology, touch target geometry, contrast, forced colors and motion behavior were not exercised.

states.loading: Tariff library uses OwnershipPanel source=tariffQuery; replay summary uses OwnershipBrief publication.source and pending run button.
states.empty: Persistent named empty panels; no-result summary preserves unknown metrics; no bands and no evidence have distinct explanatory messages.
states.error: Create/delete/replay inline MutationError; initial library failure isolated by OwnershipPanel; retained mutation success is not discarded on replay failure.
states.staleOffline: OwnershipBrief can label retained replay; library SourceContent retained branch keeps usable rows and source retry. Other replay sections do not receive publication.source.

issues.detail: Chart, ranked economics, occupancy and EvidencePanel receive result payloads but no publication.source. Pending, failed-refresh and paused/offline replay state appears only in summary/error near controls; source-independent sections can present retained results without their own trust notice.
issues.fix: Thread the existing publication.source into affected OwnershipPanel/EvidencePanel instances, retaining previous successful data; present replay-specific pending/retained context without treating missing values as zero.

visualIssues.detail: Chart hardcodes three hex colors including bright cyan; explanatory copy at :541 says alternatives are grey although current non-best is cyan. Local occupancy bars use bg-cyan-400/70 at :663.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic/chart tokens with muted current/best/alternative treatments; localize legend/status descriptions and retain all categories and user chart preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Occupancy article and editor (:814) use fixed white alpha surfaces/borders; EvidencePanel.tsx:139 also uses white alpha chrome. Theme-relative hierarchy is not expressed by canonical surface/border tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse neutral surface/border tokens in page-local chrome; shared EvidencePanel change belongs to its owner. Measure effective contrast rather than assuming token substitution proves AA.

architectureIssues.detail: Both chartData and accessible chartTableRows divide annual_cost_minor by 100 (:143,:154), whereas formatCurrencyMinor uses the actual ISO-currency fraction digits at formatters.ts:21-30. Chart numeric values can disagree with tables for zero- or three-decimal currencies. Chart axis/tooltip lacks denomination and money() uses only first-result currency across results.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing currency owner for correct minor-to-major display and currency-labelled axis/tooltip/table values; do not assume mixed results are commensurable. Resolve server currency policy before choosing any cross-currency comparison behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: Rate structure options and plan badges (:221) display raw underscore-replaced enum strings; newRate() uses visible English Standard (:61). Day suffix /d (:240) is fixed.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize enum labels/default draft label and unit-period copy through canonical catalogs while preserving raw enum values and user-authored labels.

architectureIssues.detail: Library fetch fixes limit=100 offset=0 and table supplies no server pagination. Source claims every stored plan will be evaluated when selection is empty (:459) but editing/selection only exposes the first response page.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve loaded data and coordinate existing endpoint paging/total contract; provide access to every stored plan without inventing list or full-export behavior.

order: Accessible compare names and valid end-of-day editing
priority.workspaceDecision: Keep the global vehicle owner. The route currently has no header range and uses an explicit replay window_days scenario assumption. Whether this is an independent business/model parameter or should migrate to workspace bounds is an integration decision, not proof of a backend range capability; do not add a second picker or silently discard 30/90/180/365-day semantics.

summaryMetrics: Best-case annual saving with best plan context
actions: Empty selection evaluates all according to existing page copy

dataBehavior: Keep 90-day/35-percent/zero-switching-fee defaults, all four window options, five tariff structures and USD draft default.
Preserve rate day_mask=127, start_minute=0, end_minute=1440, price_minor_per_wh=0.015, tier_upper_wh=null and January-December season defaults.
Do not add day/season/tier editing capabilities based solely on type fields; they are not existing UI controls.
Keep raw Wh/W/per-Wh/per-W data in wire/cache; useUnits and existing currency/number formatters convert only for display.
Keep submitted replay inputs separate from currently edited controls; retain success on refresh failure and clear publication on vehicle change.
Preserve tariff query key, abort forwarding, create/delete invalidations, inline errors, toasts and confirmation.
Keep no-data placeholders distinct from measured zero and keep all returned warnings, quality/evidence and explicitly unsupported computations.
Keep table IDs ownership-tariff-results and ownership-tariff-plans and preserve user persistence.
No source edits or behavior changes were performed.
